title: Concurrency
explain: Java can run work on many threads at once, and an `ExecutorService` manages them for you. Submit tasks and read the results through `Future` objects, which wait until each task is done. Java 21 adds virtual threads, which are cheap enough to start one per task.
exercise: Run five tasks that each sleep for 100 ms and time the whole run. Is it close to 100 ms or to 500 ms?
tip: Shared mutable variables need protection. Use `AtomicInteger`, `synchronized` or a concurrent collection instead of a plain `int` counter.
